item.title: New filtering and reporting capabilities in the Search Analytics API
item.content:encoded:
Search Console、Performance报告、品牌查询过滤、网页多模态搜索报告、多国多设备筛选

总结:1. 过去一年，Search Console Performance报告多次更新，目的是帮助用户更好地细分并理解流量。2. 新增品牌查询过滤器。3. 增加网页多模态搜索报告。4. 支持多国家和多设备筛选。

Over the past year, we introduced several updates to the Search Console Performance report to help you better slice and understand your traffic, including the branded queries filter, web multimodal search reporting, and multi-country and multi-device filtering.

item.title: Moving to a CDN without overwhelming your origin (or blocking Googlebot)
item.content:encoded:
关键词：CDN；边缘服务器；全球分发；降低延迟；源站防护

总结:1. CDN将站点资源分发到全球分布式高速边缘服务器，使用户就近访问。2. 这对成长型网站是重大升级。3. 它能降低访客延迟。4. 边缘节点承接流量，保护保存原始内容的后端源站免受高流量冲击。

Deploying a Content Delivery Network (CDN) to distribute your site's assets across fast, globally distributed edge servers closer to users can be a major upgrade for any growing site: it lowers visitor latency and shields your origin server (the backend source of truth holding your original content) from heavy traffic.

item.title: Supporting a shared AI training control for websites
item.content:encoded: Today, we're announcing our plans to support a shared AI training control in robots.txt. This will help websites express their AI training preferences across multiple AI providers in a single step and is based on work from the AIPREF working group at the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). This builds on our long history of providing website owners with clear controls, including through Google-Extended, the AI training control we've offered since 2023.

item.title: New learning paths: curated YouTube playlists for Search fundamentals and Technical SEO
item.content:encoded: Over the years, the Search Central YouTube channel has published hundreds of videos across various series, from Search for Beginners and Ask Googlebot to Search Console Training and Search Off the Record. While our series structure works well for deep dives and episodic updates, we know that finding a clear, sequential learning path from scratch can sometimes be challenging.

item.title: Announcing web multimodal Search performance reporting in Search Console
item.content:encoded: Understanding how users find your content is crucial for any publisher or site owner. As Search evolves to include more visual and multimodal experiences, we want to ensure you have the data you need to analyze your performance.

item.title: Search Central Live Deep Dive Europe 2026: Meet the community speakers
item.content:encoded: It's happening! We are absolutely pumped that we're just about two weeks away from Search Central Live Deep Dive Europe 2026! From September 30 to October 2, 2026, the Google Search Central team is heading to the gorgeous city of Barcelona, Spain for three days of deep technical exploration, networking, and collaboration.

item.title: Search Central Live India 2026: Bengaluru, We're Coming (For Real This Time)
item.content:encoded: Remember back in March when we told our Indian community to "sit tight" while we figured out the APAC event calendar? Hopefully, you didn't take that too literally, because sitting tight for six months is probably not great for your back. In any case, you can finally stand up and stretch: Search Central Live is officially returning to India in 2026, specifically to Bengaluru!

item.title: Search Central Live is coming to Bogota and Ciudad de México
Update to the Site Reputation Policy
item.content:encoded: In 2024, we introduced our site reputation policy to stop a practice where third-party content is published on a trusted website just to exploit that site's good reputation to rank higher in Search. This practice hurts search quality, and creates a bad experience for users.
